support.name: Customer support & resolution
support.definition: unanswered tickets or emails, call-centre bot loops and long waits, unhelpful or slow resolution.
support.action: Auto-acknowledge every ticket with a status and ETA, and offer a human hand-off after one bot turn with a live wait time.

charges.name: Brokerage, charges & fees
charges.definition: Brokerage, DP, tax or other charges seen as high, costly, expensive, unfair or hidden/unexpected. Includes very short remarks such as 'very costly', 'too expensive', 'high charges', 'too much brokerage'.
charges.action: Show a pre-trade charge breakup (brokerage, taxes, DP) on the order screen and publish a plain-language 'what you pay' page.
charges.metric: charge-related tickets, share of 1-2 star reviews

perf.name: App performance & stability
perf.definition: app is slow, hangs, crashes, screens not loading, problems after an app update.
perf.action: Profile hangs and crashes at market open, set a p95 screen-load target, and use staged rollouts with auto-rollback per app version.

features.name: Trading tools & charts
features.definition: charts and indicators, stop-loss / limit / basket orders, F&O and commodity positions, IPO tools.
features.action: Fix the most-reported chart and order issues first: keep indicator settings across updates, check stop-loss trigger logic, and verify F&O and commodity position display.

money.name: Payments, withdrawals & account access
money.definition: UPI / mandate / SIP problems, delayed withdrawals or credits, KYC, blocked or frozen accounts, login or OTP. Also includes KYC and account-opening problems: Aadhaar, PAN or document upload or verification failing (for example 'adhar not taking', 'aadhaar showing try again', 'kyc rejected'), e-sign or bank-verification failures. Treat adhar, aadhar, aadhaar, adhaar as the same word.
money.action: Show a live withdrawal status timeline and clear reasons for failed UPI, mandate and KYC steps.

unthemed.name: Unthemed
unthemed.definition: Generic praise or abuse with no specific issue, gibberish, or complaints about investment losses or market outcomes where no app, payment, charge or support problem is described.
